name: Sri Lanka
about: Two monsoons split the island: this (more-visited) coast is driest Dec–Mar. The east coast runs the opposite calendar — best May–Sep.
overview: Ancient temples, tea-covered hill country, and beaches, connected by one of the world's most scenic train rides.
costOverview: One of the cheapest countries to eat, ride, and travel around in South Asia — even the scenic train costs next to nothing.
